findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a Tests cell contains the sentence `Run tests/test_case_1.py::test_first_1.`
The node-name character class includes `.`, so extraction retains the sentence's final period. `narrow_command` then passes `tests/test_case_1.py::test_first_1.` to pytest (src/forge/fasttest.py:125), which cannot resolve the named test. Thus prose still prevents the requested tests from running. Exclude sentence punctuation from extracted node IDs and cover this sentence form in the command-level regression.
